_about: Where each tier 1–4 roadmap stands on its way into TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap, kept by hand by the upstream coordinator. stage: gate = package under the final adversarial check on a Tau Ceti lane; pr = pull request open on TauCetiRoadmap; main = merged there. one pull request per roadmap; depends_on lists the pull requests a roadmap is stacked on (its Suggested.lean imports theirs).
